title_zh_hant: 標點壓縮不是必要條件
requirement_en: Choose punctuation compression by house style, punctuation class, position and font support. In vertical CLReq treatment retain one-character advances for ：；？！; compare contextual punctuation spacing without blanket halfwidth replacement or negative tracking.
